description: Latest crypto headlines from the RSS feeds of CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Bitcoin Magazine, newest first: title, link, publisher, publish time, the coins named in the text, and at most 200 characters of the feed's own summary. Filter by words in the text (q) or by coin. Feeds are cached 5 minutes; a feed that fails is listed in unavailable. Headlines and links only, not the articles. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

coin.description: Coin ticker to filter by, e.g. BTC (optional)

q.description: Words to match in the headline or summary, up to 100 characters (optional)

name: crypto_news
title: Crypto News
